text: おつよいん　ですのね

structure.jp: おつよいん　ですのね
structure.en: my, you are strong, aren't you

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: つよいん　ですのね
patterns.explanation: んです after a describing word gives the feeling of 'so it turns out that...'. The extra の after です is a soft, ladylike touch. つよいん　ですのね = 'you really are strong, aren't you'.
